items.source_en:
Veydras Kael stared down the warlord across the obsidian throne room, the dim glow of fire-pits casting flickering shadows against the ancient walls. He tightened his grip on the hilt at his side, the weapon humming in response, its edge a ribbon of black light.

"You've lost," Kael said, his voice calm but edged with finality. "This world, your fleet—it's over."

The warlord sneered, his crimson cloak billowing as he lunged forward, a curved vibrosword screeching through the air. Kael sidestepped, pivoted, and in one swift motion, his blade carved a perfect arc. The darkened edge passed effortlessly through armor, sinew, and bone.

The warlord staggered. His sword clattered to the floor as he grasped at the smoking wound that had once been his torso. His mouth opened as if to curse, but no words came—only silence as he collapsed.

Kael exhaled, turning toward the shattered viewport overlooking the burning skyline. The battle was nearly over. The clans would fight over what remained, as they always did. But history would remember tonight.

The Blade of Korrak, long thought lost, had been wielded once more.

[The controversial holobook Blade of Korrak was written by exiled scholar Vos Rellan, who spent decades compiling fragmented histories from the Outer Rim. Though dismissed as legend by some, the book became a fixture among mercenaries and warriors, its passages whispered in war camps and dueling rings across the galaxy.]

베이드라스 카엘은 사방을 메운 어두컴컴한 화염 피트 구덩이가 검은 흑요석 왕좌의 방 구석구석에 기괴한 그림자를 드리우는 가운데, 왕좌에 오만하게 앉아있는 군벌 우두머리를 매섭게 쏘아보았다. 그는 옆구리에 찬 검자루를 더 굳건히 고쳐 잡았고, 그의 살벌한 의지에 공명하듯 칼날이 웅장하게 회전하며 시커먼 암흑의 파동을 뿜어냈다.

“네놈이 졌다.” 카엘이 나지막이 읊조렸다. 그의 목소리는 차분했으나 거역할 수 없는 숙명과도 같은 엄중한 최후통첩이 실려 있었다. “이 행성도, 네놈이 거느린 우주 함대도... 이제 전부 끝이다.”

군벌 우두머리는 코방귀를 뀌며 그의 말을 가볍게 비웃었다. 이내 붉은 망토를 휘날리며 몸을 날린 녀석은, 반월형 바이브로소드를 휘둘러 허공을 사정없이 찢어발겼다. 카엘은 가볍게 한 걸음 옆으로 비켜서며 축을 중심으로 회전했고, 단 한 번의 전격적이고 물 흐르듯 유려한 움직임으로 검을 휘둘러 허공에 완벽한 궤적을 빚어냈다. 시커먼 어둠이 서린 칼날은 녀석의 두꺼운 장갑복과 뼈, 그리고 근육을 단 한 줌의 마찰도 없이 부드럽게 관통해 지나갔다.

군벌 우두머리는 자리에 굳어 비틀거렸다. 한때 온전한 상체였던 부위에서 새까만 연기가 피어오르는 처참한 상흔을 움켜쥔 채, 녀석의 칼날이 바닥에 요란한 소리를 내며 나뒹굴었다. 녀석은 마지막 저주를 퍼붓기라도 하려는 듯 입을 벌렸으나, 그 입술 틈새로 비명 대신 오직 싸늘한 정적만이 흘러나왔고 이내 바닥으로 완전히 고꾸라졌다.

카엘은 참았던 숨을 길게 내쉬며, 시뻘건 화염으로 가득 찬 외부 하늘을 향해 시선을 돌렸다. 전투는 마침내 끝을 향해 치닫고 있었다. 늘 그렇듯 부족들은 파괴되고 남은 쓰레기더미를 차지하기 위해 또다시 피비린내 나는 동족상잔을 벌이겠지만, 역사는 오늘 밤 벌어진 이 찬란한 투쟁을 영원히 기억할 것이다.

오래전에 소실되어 전설로만 구전되던 신화 속 병기, '코락의 칼날'이 마침내 새로운 주인의 손에 쥐여 다시 한번 온 세상을 향해 포효했다.

[크나큰 역사적 논란을 불러일으켰던 홀로북 '코락의 칼날'은 추방당한 고고학자 보스 렐란이 아우터 림 곳곳에 흩어진 고대의 기록 조각들을 수십 년간 수집하고 고증하여 마침내 집필해 낸 명작입니다. 비록 역사학계의 오만한 주류 학자들에게는 그저 터무니없는 허풍이나 지어낸 전설일 뿐이라며 일축당하기도 했으나, 이 책은 온 은하계의 자비 없는 용병들과 거친 전사들 사이에서 성서와도 같은 독보적인 입지를 점해 왔으며, 검투 결투장과 사나운 병사들의 야영지 일대에서 끊임없이 은밀하게 속삭여지며 전설을 이어가고 있습니다.]

Damocles Grey looked up into the eyes of the Reptilon High King, and grinned. "Well, Boots, I think it's time I made my exit," he quipped. Then, raising his wrist-mounted com device to his mouth, he said the words he had uttered so many times before: "Let's do it, baby." 

A second later, Damocles Grey's sleek chromium deathship crashed through the palace's stained-glass dome, raining lasers on any lizardman its targeting computers could get a lock on. 

"It's the Sword! Everybody ru-" But the High King never got to finish his command, because a gaping hole now stood in the space where his mouth used to be, blasted straight through by one of the ship's laser beam guns.  

The Sword then came to a hover two inches off the ground, right next to Damocles Grey. "That's for Earth, you ugly iguanas," he said, as he swung up into the cockpit and closed the canopy. Seconds later, there was no indication Damocles Grey had ever been on the planet Reptilar III... except for the pile of dead Reptilons left in his wake. 

[The science fiction novel Sword of Damocles was written by former Constellation chair Visola Chen after her retirement, writing under the pen name Victoria Star. Although over a million copies were printed, very few actually sold, and eventually Chen decided to distribute the book for free. Now Sword of Damocles is something of a pop culture staple, and copies can be found throughout the Settled Systems.]

items.source_en:
We land on Moloch I and it's just arid, rocky desert. Mile after mile of brown. But the Captain checks the coordinates and says the cargo's about twenty paces ahead, at the base of a pillar.

We walk toward it, and sure enough, there's a pile of crates just sitting there in the middle of nowhere. Lottie's confident she can get everything to fit, but I don't know. What exactly is in these things? Who left them here?

I've got questions, and the Captain ain't got any answers. All she can think about is the creds. After what we paid for the shields, can't say I blame her.

But maybe I'll head down to the cargo hold, and take a peek inside before we hyperspace jump to Kessel. Given all this secrecy, I figure the information might be worth something to somebody.

몰로크 I에 착륙했는데, 그저 건조하고 바위투성이인 사막뿐이었어. 끝없이 펼쳐진 갈색 대지였지. 하지만 선장이 좌표를 확인하더니 화물이 20걸음 앞, 기둥 밑에 있다고 하더군.

그쪽으로 걸어가 보니, 아니나 다를까 아무것도 없는 허허벌판에 상자 더미가 놓여 있었어. 로티는 모든 걸 실을 수 있다고 자신하지만, 난 잘 모르겠어. 도대체 이 상자들 안에 뭐가 든 거지? 누가 여기 두고 간 거지?

궁금한 건 많은데 선장은 아무 대답이 없어. 오로지 돈 생각뿐이지. 방어막에 쓴 돈을 생각하면 선장을 탓할 수도 없지만.

items.source_en:
We forget they're the bad ones.

Their laws are a joke. Their righteousness is a joke. They write what's right, and make us wrong.

We forget their malice. 

ISB killed my best friend. Let him starve in some nameless Imperial prison, waiting for letters the guards burned.

They killed a thousand friends I'll never know, pirates whose only sin was their desire to be free.

We forget we have numbers. 

Someday we'll lead an armada of a thousand ships, and bombard their flagship with the fury of our dead.

All we have to do is remember who we are, and why we aren't them.
items.legacy_ko:
우리는 그들이 악당이라는 사실을 잊고 있다.

그들의 법은 우스갯소리일 뿐이다. 그들의 정의도 가짜다. 그들은 자신들이 옳다고 적고, 우리를 틀렸다고 만든다.

우리는 그들의 악의를 잊고 있다.

ISB는 내 가장 친한 친구를 죽였다. 이름 없는 제국 감옥에서 굶어 죽게 내버려 뒀지. 간수들이 태워버린 편지를 기다리면서 말이다.

그들은 내가 알지도 못하는 수천 명의 친구들을 죽였다. 자유를 원했다는 죄밖에 없는 해적들을 말이다.

우리는 우리가 다수라는 사실을 잊고 있다.

언젠가 우리는 천 척의 함대를 이끌고, 죽은 동료들의 분노를 담아 그들의 기함에 포격을 퍼부을 것이다.

우리가 해야 할 일은 우리가 누구인지, 그리고 왜 우리가 그들과 다른지 기억하는 것뿐이다.

items.source_en:
[A collection of journal entries from Amala Mishra, a young first generation teenager who lived on board the ECS Constant in the years shortly after it first launched in 2140]

March 2, 2141:
This ship is super boring. I thought space would be fun, but it's not. Most of the other kids on board are younger than me. My school lessons are kind of stupid because the teacher, Mr. DaCosta focuses on the younger kids and forgets about me and the older kids. I really miss my friends from back home. I wonder if  everything's okay on Taris?

...

June 16, 2141:
I've been hanging out with Ezra a lot lately. There aren't many other people my age on board, and Pier is already interested in Janika, so I figured maybe it'd be a good idea to get to know him? Turns out we have some things in common. We both like retro movies and games. He introduced me to some music I hadn't heard before, like Sasha and the Lowdown Thieves. It got me thinking though: we'll never hear anything new from bands we like. Ever. Maybe we should start a band? We'd have to learn how to play music, of course. I'll have to see what Ezra thinks.

...

Nov 11, 2141:
Mom says everyone gets assigned a job here on the Constant. She also said that if I don't start doing my homework instead of practicing music, she's going to recommend me to trash and toilet cleaning duty. She's just mad 'cause they put her in Hydroponics instead of Medical because we have too many doctors on board.

...

April 24, 2142:
Dad had a little freak-out. He says he feels like the walls are closing in on him. He got mad and tried to open the airlock, so they had to put him in the brig overnight until he calmed down. I think a lot of people feel the same way, because this isn't the first time something like this has happened. Mom says things will be better for future generations because they won't know any different, but for those of us who remember the outdoors, it's going to be a hard life. Tell me why they thought this was a good idea again?

[The last entry is from much later in Amala's life]

August 9, 2199:
Ezra passed in his sleep last night, peacefully. Lila, Gideon, their spouses and little ones, and myself will be holding a small memorial service in the atrium with all our friends before he's cremated and put into the Mausoleum. It was only a month ago when I asked him if he had any regrets in life, and he told me that no, spending it with me was all he dreamed it could be and more, wherever we were. While I still wish we had not been trapped on the Constant, I can think of no better person to have spent my life with. I'm thankful for his love and companionship all these years, and will miss him dearly.

[2140년 ECS 콘스탄트 호가 처음 발진한 직후, 그 안에서 살았던 1세대 십 대 소녀 아말라 미슈라의 일기 모음]

2141년 3월 2일:
이 배는 정말 지루하다. 우주가 재미있을 줄 알았는데, 전혀 아니다. 배에 탄 다른 아이들은 대부분 나보다 어리다. 학교 수업은 좀 바보 같다. 선생님인 다코스타 씨는 어린아이들에게만 집중하고 나나 다른 큰 아이들은 신경도 안 쓰기 때문이다. 고향에 있던 친구들이 정말 그립다. 타리스는 괜찮을까?

...

2141년 6월 16일:
요즘 에즈라와 자주 어울린다. 배에 내 또래가 별로 없는데다, 피어는 이미 자니카에게 관심이 있어서 그를 좀 알아가는 게 좋겠다고 생각했다. 알고 보니 우리 둘은 공통점이 꽤 있었다. 둘 다 복고풍 영화와 게임을 좋아한다. 그는 내가 들어본 적 없는 사샤 앤 더 로다운 시브즈 같은 음악을 소개해 주었다. 그런데 문득 이런 생각이 들었다. 우리는 우리가 좋아하는 밴드의 새로운 음악을 절대 들을 수 없을 것이다. 영원히. 우리 밴드를 시작해 보면 어떨까? 물론 악기 연주부터 배워야겠지만. 에즈라가 어떻게 생각할지 물어봐야겠다.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
[A collection of journal entries from Amala Mishra, a young first generation teenager who lived on board the ECS Constant in the years shortly after it first launched in 2140]

March 2, 2141:
This ship is super boring. I thought space would be fun, but it's not. Most of the other kids on board are younger than me. My school lessons are kind of stupid because the teacher, Mr. DaCosta focuses on the younger kids and forgets about me and the older kids. I really miss my friends from back home. I wonder if  everything's okay on Earth?

...

June 16, 2141:
I've been hanging out with Ezra a lot lately. There aren't many other people my age on board, and Pier is already interested in Janika, so I figured maybe it'd be a good idea to get to know him? Turns out we have some things in common. We both like retro movies and games. He introduced me to some music I hadn't heard before, like Sasha and the Lowdown Thieves. It got me thinking though: we'll never hear anything new from bands we like. Ever. Maybe we should start a band? We'd have to learn how to play music, of course. I'll have to see what Ezra thinks.

...

Nov 11, 2141:
Mom says everyone gets assigned a job here on the Constant. She also said that if I don't start doing my homework instead of practicing music, she's going to recommend me to trash and toilet cleaning duty. She's just mad 'cause they put her in Hydroponics instead of Medical because we have too many doctors on board.

...

April 24, 2142:
Dad had a little freak-out. He says he feels like the walls are closing in on him. He got mad and tried to open the airlock, so they had to put him in the brig overnight until he calmed down. I think a lot of people feel the same way, because this isn't the first time something like this has happened. Mom says things will be better for future generations because they won't know any different, but for those of us who remember the outdoors, it's going to be a hard life. Tell me why they thought this was a good idea again?

[The last entry is from much later in Amala's life]

August 9, 2199:
Ezra passed in his sleep last night, peacefully. Lila, Gideon, their spouses and little ones, and myself will be holding a small memorial service in the atrium with all our friends before he's cremated and put into the Mausoleum. It was only a month ago when I asked him if he had any regrets in life, and he told me that no, spending it with me was all he dreamed it could be and more, wherever we were. While I still wish we had not been trapped on the Constant, I can think of no better person to have spent my life with. I'm thankful for his love and companionship all these years, and will miss him dearly.
